description: This Java source file defines the JSONConverters class and nested classes for converting JSON objects to and from List and Map structures within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JSONConverters
classes.description: Contains nested converter classes for JSON to List/Map and vice versa, implementing the ConverterLoader interface.

classes.name: JSONConverters.JSONToList
classes.description: Converts a JSON object to a List<Object>.

classes.name: JSONConverters.JSONToMap
classes.description: Converts a JSON object to a Map<String, Object>.

classes.name: JSONConverters.ListToJSON
classes.description: Converts a List<Object> to a JSON object.

classes.name: JSONConverters.MapToJSON
classes.description: Converts a Map<String, Object> to a JSON object.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts JSON to List<Object> or Map<String, Object> for respective classes, JSON to JSON for ListToJSON and MapToJSON classes.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters into the Converters registry.
